source: This vase has fingerprints on it. Is there something inside?
It needs dusting. I'll have to have my wife arrange for the servants to come by.
There's something in here.
(A... vial?)
(It stinks of... some kind of noxious fumes.)
(This must be the poison he used to kill King Hamlet.)
(I'd better pocket it.)
{It's... empty.}
{But there is a lingering smell. Something was hidden here.)
Is this a drawer inlaid into the table?
What's inside this drawer, my lord?
It hasn't been opened in years. I'm certain the hinges are rusted shut.
Someone left a bucket here. It looks like it's full of something.
Oh. Eurgh.
Well, I certainly regret looking in there. If this is meant to be a chamberpot, no one's cleaned it in ages.
I already know what's in that bucket. I'm not looking again.
That's Prince Fortinbras's bucket now.
Lord Fortinbras is in there.
But shall not remain so.
Oh? And what makes you so certain of that?
I'd be a poor tactician if I disclosed my every possible move.
I don't believe I've ever formally made your acquaintance, though by the look of you I know you are that Lady Ophelia.
If you expect me to have pleasantries to exchange with you, I don't. You're trying to burn my country to the ground.
How unfortunate that this is your perception of my mission.
The Danish are like neglected dogs, snarling at anything unfamiliar. They have not known the touch of a kind master.
When I am ruler of Denmark, allow me then to show you what such a kind touch looks like.
You keep away from my daughter! I may be a weak, sick old man, but there's strength in these bones enough to strangle you yet, Norway.
Hmm. No need for that. I suspect the lady is capable of defending her own honor.
Ruler of Denmark is quite a leap for you in the present moment. For now, the only thing you're ruling is this cell. Farewell, and enjoy it.
Yes, farewell. For now.
Still lingering?
I'm not a monster, Lady Ophelia. No more so, at least, than any of the men in this dour place.
It's my fault you're here.
Don't say that, my love. My faults and my actions are my own. It is by my hand that I am here.
(By your hand, perhaps, but I'm the one who tipped that hand.)
The cell door is locked at the moment.
Lady Ophelia, while I ordinarily respect your particular habit of, er, rummaging...
Those are my personal belongings.
Lady Ophelia, don' go gettin' in trouble wiv Bernardo!
He really dislikes it when yeh look through 'is things!
Las' time 'e caught me, I wos cleanin' boots until my hands got sores...
Let me see if I can find what Claudius asked Bernardo to hide. --Ah. This must be it.
It's... a letter? And it looks like the seal's been broken, so I can't quite tell whose seal it is, but it's rather elaborate.
This is horrible.
I'm certain Gertrude must not yet know. What am I to do with this?
And here's that letter again.
It looks like there's nothing else here at the moment, though.
I fear you and I shall never be together, Mother.
Father comes to visit her sometimes. Perhaps I should join him. He might like that.
Fortinbras will cross Denmark

source: Let's talk of the future. What are your intentions?
For the future? Hmm. You know, Ophelia, I had not thoroughly contemplated that yet.
For the time being, my place is here at Elsinore. But now that you mention it...
Some of my men already know this, but I've been performing as Lady Katherine at the theatre for a summer.
I've even been invited to go to London with a new troupe!
...And I've been feeling more like a woman on more days than ever before, I think.
I suppose it'll be interesting to meet people as Lady Bernardo who have never known Lord Bernardo.
Indeed, in much the same way my men 'met' Katherine, I suppose I'll have to introduce both sides of me at some point.
It seems now to me the world is full of such possibility of expression, of life. I never thought of it like that before.
And it's high time I stopped caring for the thoughts of others and lived what is truest to my soul.
'Come, you spirits, unsex me here' and all that!
What are your plans for the future?
The future? Goodness, Ophelia! What d'yeh expect I am? Some kind o' all-knowin', all-sentient god of knowledge?
I canna' even think about breakfast tomorrow, let alone anythin' past that.
Isn't the guards' breakfast the same each day? I thought it was porridge and cold meats.
Lord above, yer right!
Oho! I feel like I've been freed up t'ponder all kinds o' vast mysteries, now...
The future... hmmm... the future...
Me? Why, I've no idea. Best to ask Guilda on that one. She makes all our travel decisions.
So long as whatever hearth we find ourselves before is warm and well-fed, that's all I need.
Why are you asking me? Rosie always knows where we're going next. I have no clue!
I just hope the food's good. It's been excellent here, but you Danes are so sewn-up.
Bring on the drama, I say! We just came from Wittenberg, after all. The bar is set high.
Oh, me? I'm returning to Wittenberg shortly.
Now that Father is properly buried and memorialized, it's time to go.
I realized recently I had the aptitude for scholarship. Thinking myself to death is my favorite sport.
